dual.hypothesis: Full EnergyCA-LLM, reused across every panel

mlp_schema.hypothesis: Two-layer trainable MLP on normalized token-frequency facts; same Qwen tokenizer and512-token truncation,4096 fixed tokenID-hash bins; no language-model weights

frozen_random.hypothesis: Fresh seed2027 ordinary Qwen3-8B architecture, frozen; same public tokenizer and mean pooling, no public pretrained weights

numeric_state.hypothesis: Zero semantic state in both controller branches; retain numerical history and availability

semantic_state.hypothesis: Zero pooled history in both controller branches; retain numerical predictor inputs and availability

concat_only.hypothesis: Zero only the projected semantic-numerical product branch

none.hypothesis: Zero adapter output and its candidate-energy penalty

fixed.hypothesis: Both gate factors fixed to one; learn shared low-rank bases

task_specific.hypothesis: Four separate rank8 basis pairs per layer, cloned from common initialization; gates remain dynamic

rank_only.hypothesis: Learn vector gate; strength fixed to one

strength_only.hypothesis: Vector gate fixed to one; learn scalar strength

no_availability.hypothesis: Remove explicit available_groups text and zero ten availability inputs in controller/future projection; retain masks and observation-age descriptions

training.loss: equal-task TRAIN-mean-absolute-scale masked Huber1 plus1e-4 pre-strength branch energy

selection.metric: complete four-task VAL asset-macro NMAE mean

condition_evaluation.selection: only complete-context source VAL; frozen selected weights for all conditions
condition_evaluation.removal: mask historical non-target non-calendar channels only
condition_evaluation.delay: mask latest24 physical hours of these channels; retain old weather descriptors and age
condition_evaluation.unchanged_texts: reuse cached vectors exactly by full text SHA; no stochastic recomputation of unchanged descriptions
